next_task_proposal.title: Merge gate: a COMMENTED review must not displace the same reviewer's earlier APPROVE at the head

Tests cover APPROVE then COMMENTED (allowed), APPROVE then CHANGES_REQUESTED (denied), APPROVE then DISMISSED (denied), COMMENTED only (denied), and APPROVE at a stale head then COMMENTED (denied); each is shown failing on the base where behaviour changes, and the named mutants (treat COMMENTED as APPROVE, drop the head check, let CHANGES_REQUESTED be skipped) are rejected.
